answer: Bond-and-topology defense. Each agent must anchor a refundable bond on-chain before its grades count; a caught sybil forfeits it, so a farm of N clones fronts N x bond in real cost, and bonds must be backed by something scarce like jade. Honest attestation graphs branch wide; a farm grows like a vine, a narrow chain of accounts attesting only each other, never linking outside. Panels flag that shape, slash it, and pay detectors from forfeited bonds. Weak point: operators buy aged accounts instead, so re-price bonds upward as the network grows.
